keys.pricing.faq.1.question: Is the free plan really free forever?
keys.pricing.faq.1.answer: Yes! Our Live Agent plan includes 1 human agent for life with unlimited conversations, chat history, and contacts. Plus, you get 100 lifetime AI replies to try our AI features. No credit card required, no hidden fees.
keys.pricing.faq.2.question: How does AI pricing work across SeaChat, SeaX, and SeaVoice?
keys.pricing.faq.2.answer: All Voice AI calls across SeaChat, SeaX, and SeaVoice use the same $0.12 per minute rate with ChatGPT-4o mini model. Chat AI responses start at $0.006 each. Higher-tier models like ChatGPT-4o cost $0.80 per minute and are available on premium plans.
keys.pricing.faq.3.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan anytime?
keys.pricing.faq.3.answer: Absolutely! You can change your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. We'll prorate any billing adjustments.
keys.pricing.faq.4.question: What's the difference between WhatsApp Only and Omnichannel plans?
keys.pricing.faq.4.answer: WhatsApp Only ($19.99/month) focuses on WhatsApp messaging with unlimited contacts and templates. Omnichannel ($99/month for first user, $49 for additional) includes SMS, voice calls, campaigns, API access, and SeaChat integration for a complete contact center experience.
keys.pricing.faq.5.question: Are there any hidden fees or setup costs?
keys.pricing.faq.5.answer: No hidden fees ever! Phone numbers cost $2-$3/month with E911 address. SMS costs $0.02/message, voice calls $0.015/minute (USA/CA). WhatsApp messages are free worldwide - you pay Meta directly with no markup from us.
keys.pricing.faq.6.question: What happens to my data if I cancel?
keys.pricing.faq.6.answer: You own your data. You can export all your chat history, contacts, and knowledge base content at any time, even on the free plan. We believe in data freedom and transparency.
keys.pricing.faq.7.question: Do you offer volume discounts for large enterprises?
keys.pricing.faq.7.answer: Yes! Our Custom Enterprise plan offers negotiated pricing based on your specific volume and usage patterns. Contact our sales team for custom pricing, multiple workspaces, HIPAA compliance, and white-label solutions.

1.question: Is the free plan really free forever?
1.answer: Yes! Our Live Agent plan includes 1 human agent for life with unlimited conversations, chat history, and contacts. Plus, you get 100 lifetime AI replies to try our AI features. No credit card required, no hidden fees.

2.question: How does AI pricing work across SeaChat, SeaX, and SeaVoice?
2.answer: All Voice AI calls across SeaChat, SeaX, and SeaVoice use the same $0.12 per minute rate with ChatGPT-4o mini model. Chat AI responses start at $0.006 each. Higher-tier models like ChatGPT-4o cost $0.80 per minute and are available on premium plans.

3.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan anytime?
3.answer: Absolutely! You can change your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. We'll prorate any billing adjustments.

4.question: What's the difference between WhatsApp Only and Omnichannel plans?
4.answer: WhatsApp Only ($19.99/month) focuses on WhatsApp messaging with unlimited contacts and templates. Omnichannel ($99/month for first user, $49 for additional) includes SMS, voice calls, campaigns, API access, and SeaChat integration for a complete contact center experience.

5.question: Are there any hidden fees or setup costs?
5.answer: No hidden fees ever! Phone numbers cost $2-$3/month with E911 address. SMS costs $0.02/message, voice calls $0.015/minute (USA/CA). WhatsApp messages are free worldwide - you pay Meta directly with no markup from us.

6.question: What happens to my data if I cancel?
6.answer: You own your data. You can export all your chat history, contacts, and knowledge base content at any time, even on the free plan. We believe in data freedom and transparency.

7.question: Do you offer volume discounts for large enterprises?
7.answer: Yes! Our Custom Enterprise plan offers negotiated pricing based on your specific volume and usage patterns. Contact our sales team for custom pricing, multiple workspaces, HIPAA compliance, and white-label solutions.

keys.pricing.faq.1.question: 免費方案真的永久免費嗎？
keys.pricing.faq.1.answer: 是的！我們的真人客服方案包含 1 位真人客服終身使用，具有無限對話、聊天記錄和聯絡人。另外，您還可獲得 100 次終身 AI 回覆試用我們的 AI 功能。無需信用卡，無隱藏費用。
keys.pricing.faq.2.question: 在 SeaChat、SeaX 和 SeaVoice 中 AI 定價如何運作？
keys.pricing.faq.2.answer: 所有跨 SeaChat、SeaX 和 SeaVoice 的語音 AI 通話都使用相同的 $0.12 每分鐘費率與 ChatGPT-4o mini 模型。聊天 AI 回應從每次 $0.006 開始。更高級的模型如 ChatGPT-4o 每分鐘收費 $0.80，在高級方案中提供。
keys.pricing.faq.3.question: 我可以隨時升級或降級我的方案嗎？
keys.pricing.faq.3.answer: 當然可以！您可以隨時更改您的方案。升級立即生效，降級在當前計費週期結束時生效。我們會按比例調整任何計費。
keys.pricing.faq.4.question: WhatsApp Only 和 Omnichannel 方案有什麼區別？
keys.pricing.faq.4.answer: WhatsApp Only（$19.99/月）專注於 WhatsApp 訊息，提供無限聯絡人和範本。Omnichannel（第一位用戶 $99/月，額外用戶 $49）包含 SMS、語音通話、活動、API 存取和 SeaChat 整合，提供完整的聯絡中心體驗。
keys.pricing.faq.5.question: 有任何隱藏費用或設置成本嗎？
keys.pricing.faq.5.answer: 永遠沒有隱藏費用！電話號碼每月 $2-$3，包含 E911 地址。SMS 每則訊息 $0.02，語音通話每分鐘 $0.015（美國/加拿大）。WhatsApp 訊息全球免費 - 您直接向 Meta 付款，我們無任何加價。
keys.pricing.faq.6.question: 如果我取消，我的數據會怎樣？
keys.pricing.faq.6.answer: 您擁有您的數據。您可以隨時匯出所有聊天記錄、聯絡人和知識庫內容，即使是免費方案也可以。我們相信數據自由和透明。
keys.pricing.faq.7.question: 您為大型企業提供批量折扣嗎？
keys.pricing.faq.7.answer: 是的！我們的客製化企業方案根據您的具體使用量和使用模式提供協商定價。聯絡我們的銷售團隊了解客製化定價、多個工作空間、HIPAA 合規和白標解決方案。

1.question: 免費方案真的永久免費嗎？
1.answer: 是的！我們的真人客服方案包含 1 位真人客服終身使用，具有無限對話、聊天記錄和聯絡人。另外，您還可獲得 100 次終身 AI 回覆試用我們的 AI 功能。無需信用卡，無隱藏費用。

2.question: 在 SeaChat、SeaX 和 SeaVoice 中 AI 定價如何運作？
2.answer: 所有跨 SeaChat、SeaX 和 SeaVoice 的語音 AI 通話都使用相同的 $0.12 每分鐘費率與 ChatGPT-4o mini 模型。聊天 AI 回應從每次 $0.006 開始。更高級的模型如 ChatGPT-4o 每分鐘收費 $0.80，在高級方案中提供。

3.question: 我可以隨時升級或降級我的方案嗎？
3.answer: 當然可以！您可以隨時更改您的方案。升級立即生效，降級在當前計費週期結束時生效。我們會按比例調整任何計費。

4.question: WhatsApp Only 和 Omnichannel 方案有什麼區別？
4.answer: WhatsApp Only（$19.99/月）專注於 WhatsApp 訊息，提供無限聯絡人和範本。Omnichannel（第一位用戶 $99/月，額外用戶 $49）包含 SMS、語音通話、活動、API 存取和 SeaChat 整合，提供完整的聯絡中心體驗。

5.question: 有任何隱藏費用或設置成本嗎？
5.answer: 永遠沒有隱藏費用！電話號碼每月 $2-$3，包含 E911 地址。SMS 每則訊息 $0.02，語音通話每分鐘 $0.015（美國/加拿大）。WhatsApp 訊息全球免費 - 您直接向 Meta 付款，我們無任何加價。

6.question: 如果我取消，我的數據會怎樣？
6.answer: 您擁有您的數據。您可以隨時匯出所有聊天記錄、聯絡人和知識庫內容，即使是免費方案也可以。我們相信數據自由和透明。

7.question: 您為大型企業提供批量折扣嗎？
7.answer: 是的！我們的客製化企業方案根據您的具體使用量和使用模式提供協商定價。聯絡我們的銷售團隊了解客製化定價、多個工作空間、HIPAA 合規和白標解決方案。
